questions.q: You spoke to a contact who is not yet in People. Why does it matter?
o: It does not - the email is stored anyway
Their email history is stored but shows on no record until the person exists
The CRM will reject the email
It blocks the opportunity from being created
questions.e: The mail is captured, but with no matching person it attaches to nothing. Two clicks - name, email, company - and the whole thread appears on the record.

questions.q: An order lands. What is the correct stage?
questions.e: Customer is our won stage. Then correct the amount, fill quoteRef, set closeDate to the day the order landed and probability to 100.

questions.q: Moving a deal to Customer in the CRM...
o: Raises the order in Intact automatically
Creates a Case for Customer Operations
Does not create anything in Intact - the order is still raised there by hand
questions.e: The CRM stage change is a record of the win. Someone still raises the order in Intact and Customer Operations runs the delivery.

questions.q: You are closing a deal as lost. What must you not do?
o: Blank out the amount and close date
Set competitorDisplaced if we lost to a competitor
questions.e: Leave the amount and close date exactly as they were. They are the raw material for win-rate and pricing analysis - blanking them destroys the evidence.
